title: One Invasive Fish Wiped Out 79% of a Reef's Babies in 5 Weeks

scenes.text: One fish erased 79 percent of a reef's babies.
Scientists put lionfish on small Bahamas reefs for five weeks.
Young native fish dropped by an average of 79 percent.
Lionfish don't belong in the Atlantic. They're invaders.
One big lionfish ate 20 small fish in 30 minutes.
That fast, a reef lost almost four fifths of its next generation.

description:
One lionfish-stocked reef lost 79 percent of its baby fish.
In a five-week experiment in the Bahamas, lionfish cut the number of young native fish by an average of 79 percent. They are invaders in the Atlantic, and one big lionfish ate 20 small fish in 30 minutes.
Should we hunt them? Comment below.
first_comment: Would you rather see lionfish on a reef or on a dinner plate? Tell us why.
